title: Attackers actively exploit Drupal installer vulnerabilities, including Drupal core access bypass CVE-2026-136716 and RCE CVE-2026-132165. Pa
content_md:
Attackers actively exploit Drupal installer vulnerabilities, including Drupal core access bypass CVE-2026-136716 and RCE CVE-2026-132165. Pa

via Mastodon https://securityonline.info/cve-2026-136716-drupal-installer-vulnerabilities/?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=jetpack_social

CVE-2026-132165.evidence: Event reports attackers actively exploiting the Drupal core access bypass flaw.

CVE-2026-136716.evidence: Event names CVE-2026-136716 among the actively exploited Drupal installer vulnerabilities.
